notes: Bash permissions were inconsistently granted to subagents - the with_skill explore-model run got partial Bash access (search, validate worked) while old_skill got none. This makes the explore-model comparison unreliable.

Both coverage-gaps runs fell back to file reading instead of using reqvire search --not-have-relations. This is a non-discriminating failure - neither skill version prompted the agent to use this specific filter.
add-requirement is the cleanest eval - both versions passed all assertions, but the new skill was faster (110s vs 170s) and used fewer tokens (31k vs 38k).
The new skill's compact format appears to reduce token usage across all evals (~26% fewer tokens on average).
